verdicts.reason: A avoids overlaps, but the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a small pill lined up with the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, so it no longer stands out. The italic subhead is crammed into a narrow five-line column, the logo wordmark looks broken ('SOLST CE'), the legal text is tiny and the missing-asset placeholder is still visible. B is clearly broken: the '6:00 pm… Pier 9' line is printed on top of the legal text and can't be read, the ALL AGES and TASTINGS pills overlap each other, the rotated orange can collides with the RSVP button, and the 'missing asset' box is still there.
